Technology

Recognition that works in the real world.

Gestalt's AR engine uses CLIP embeddings and spatial anchoring to identify artworks instantly — even in challenging lighting, from oblique angles, and across multiple resolutions.

CLIP-Based Recognition

Vector embeddings trained on millions of art images enable sub-second identification without QR codes. Gestalt matches a visitor's camera frame against a venue's embedding index in real time, with no network round-trip required for the comparison step.

Multi-Anchor Fallback

When visual recognition confidence drops below threshold, GPS and QR anchors ensure visitors always connect to the right work. The system degrades gracefully — visitors experience a seamless interaction regardless of which recognition pathway fires.

On-Device + Cloud Hybrid

Embeddings run on-device for speed; description generation and audio synthesis happen in the cloud for richness. This split keeps recognition latency under one second while allowing the full Gemini-powered description pipeline to run without compromise.

< 1s recognition
4 image inputs per artwork
97% match accuracy (beta)
